visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a wide shot under bright daylight, a group of people is on a bamboo raft in a calm river. Two men stand in the water, waist-deep, pushing the raft which carries several seated individuals wearing straw hats. (2) The scene shifts to a man with an arm tattoo helping a young boy and a young girl hold a fishing rod by a large outdoor pond. The background features grassy banks and other fishing structures. (3) A close-up shows the man with tattoos holding a small, silver fish on a hook, showing it to the young boy who looks on with curiosity. (4) A medium shot follows the young boy in a white t-shirt as he holds the fishing rod, looking down at the pond. (5) The camera captures a close-up of the young girl in a pink dress as she crouches and carefully uses her hands to prepare fish bait in a small purple bucket. (6) In a medium shot, the boy and girl stand together by the pond's edge, holding fishing rods and looking towards the water. (7) The man with tattoos is seen winding a fishing reel quickly, successfully pulling a small fish out of the water. (8) A medium shot shows the young boy putting on a large pair of green waterproof fishing waders, also known as 'frog suits'. (9) The group is shown boarding the bamboo raft from the grassy bank. The man in the black tank top assists the children as they step onto the bamboo poles. (10) A wide shot shows the raft in the middle of the river, with two men pushing it through the water while the rest of the group sits comfortably on the raft. (11) A close-up shows hands wearing a white glove holding a glass jar, while another hand places small fish caught in a net into the jar. (12) The boy is seen fishing alone on a concrete embankment next to a white utility building by the pond. (13) The final shot is a group photo of everyone on the raft, smiling and waving, with the man with tattoos making a peace sign.
